name: NDA General Ability Mock Test - Practice Test 1

questions.question: Where is the National Defence Academy (NDA) located?
questions.hint: NDA is located in Khadakwasla near Pune, Maharashtra.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.hint: The President of India is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces.

questions.question: Which is the oldest paramilitary force in India?
questions.hint: Assam Rifles, established in 1835 as Cachar Levy, is the oldest.

questions.question: The head of the Indian Army is called:
questions.hint: The head of the Indian Army is the Chief of Army Staff (COAS).

questions.question: In which year was the Kargil War fought?
questions.hint: The Kargil War was fought between May and July 1999.

questions.question: The famous Battle of Haldighati was fought in which year?
questions.hint: The Battle of Haldighati was fought on June 18, 1576 between Akbar's forces led by Man Singh I and Maharana Pratap.

questions.question: Which boundary line separates India and China?
questions.hint: The McMahon Line is the boundary line between Tibet/China and northeast India.

questions.question: Which is the highest peacetime gallantry award in India?
questions.hint: Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime military decoration, equivalent to the Param Vir Chakra (war-time).

questions.question: The historical Treaty of Versailles was signed in which year?
questions.hint: The Treaty of Versailles was signed on June 28, 1919, officially ending World War I.

questions.question: Who is regarded as the father of the Indian Space Programme?
questions.hint: Dr. Vikram Sarabhai led the establishment of ISRO and space research in India.

questions.question: What is dry ice chemically?
questions.hint: Dry ice is the common name for solid carbon dioxide (CO2).

questions.question: Solder used in electronics is an alloy of which metals?
questions.hint: Standard electrical solder consists of tin and lead.

questions.question: Which gas is filled inside common household electric bulbs?
questions.hint: Bulbs are filled with chemically inactive gases like nitrogen or argon to prevent filament oxidation.

questions.question: The red color of human blood is due to the presence of which protein?
questions.hint: Hemoglobin is the iron-containing oxygen-transport metalloprotein in red blood cells.

questions.question: Which Part of the Indian Constitution contains the Fundamental Rights?
questions.hint: Articles 12 to 35 in Part III of the Constitution guarantee Fundamental Rights to citizens.
